Headquarters: Remote - Austin; Remote - CA; Remote - Chicago; Remote - Dallas; Remote - Houston; Remote - Seattle

Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.
About the role:

Samsara's Commercial Customer Success team supports hundreds of customers who depend on our platform every day to manage their fleets, equipment, and operations. These customers don't just need software — they need a partner who helps them get to value fast, identifies and mitigates risk, and keeps finding new ways to put Samsara to work for their business.

We're building the AI infrastructure to make that possible at scale. And we need an applied AI specialist to build it — and own it.

As an embedded AI Engineer in Customer Success, you'll design, build, test, deploy, and continuously maintain agentic solutions that power this next chapter. You'll own the full lifecycle: from the first prompt through production, from launch through every iteration as our Customer Success playbooks evolve, and as our product ships new features and real-world performance data surfaces what needs to change next. The agents you build will only be as good as the care you put into keeping them relevant and reliable over time.

This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the US except the San Francisco Bay Metro Area, NYC Metro Area, and Washington, D.C. Metro Area. 

You should apply if:

• You want to impact the industries that run our world: Every phone call you answer and every email you send can affect whether truck drivers deliver goods on time and without accidents, whether students get dropped off safely from school, or whether power gets restored quickly after a natural disaster.

• You thrive the most when solving problems: Our constantly expanding technology and the complexities faced by our customers provide an exciting range of challenges for our Customer Success teams. With a growth mindset and a desire to learn, you will strategically partner with our customers to find unique solutions to help keep their operations safe, efficient, and sustainable.

• You are a natural relationship builder: Whether the relationship is with our customers or with cross-functional teams in Samsara, you are in constant communication and collaboration with key stakeholders to win as a team.

• You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. This Customer Success team is still shaping its future and you will have plenty of autonomy and opportunities to master your craft in a hyper growth environment.

• You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by the best and brightest professionals out there.

Your core responsibility is the full lifecycle of Samsara's customer-facing AI agents

In this role, you will: 

• Build: Design agent architectures, write prompts, integrate with external systems (Salesforce, Samsara platform, Customer Success tools), and write clean Python code that the team can maintain.

• Test: Define success criteria and evaluation frameworks before you write the first line of code. Build automated test suites that cover real-world scenarios, edge cases, and known failure modes.

• Deploy: Own the deployment, versioning, and rollback plan for every agent. Ensure agents are production-ready before they reach CSMs or customers.

• Monitor: Track agent performance in production — monitor accuracy, latency, failure rates, and customer outcomes. Detect drift before anyone has to tell you something's wrong.

• Maintain & Iterate: Update agents continuously as Samsara's product evolves, Customer Success playbooks change, and real-world data indicates what needs improvement.

• Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

WHAT YOU'LL ACCOMPLISH

In your first 30 days

• Embed with the Commercial Customer Success team to understand what Customer Success Managers actually do — their workflows, their friction points, and the customer moments that move the needle

• Get fluent in Samsara's platform, data model, and existing Customer Success tooling stack

• Define success metrics and an evaluation framework for the first agent on the roadmap — before you write a single line of code

In your first 90 days

• Ship the first production agentic solution that meaningfully improves customer outcomes that lead to revenue retention and/or growth 

• Build the monitoring and iteration loop from day one — so you have a clear signal on what's working, what's drifting, and what needs to change

• Spec the second agentic solution to detect and mitigate risk within accounts and start building, applying lessons from the first

• Provide an estimated start date for the value gap detection and product consultation — identifies underutilization and leads product consultations via text or call.

By the end of your first year

• Own a portfolio of three or more production agentic solutions running reliably in the Commercial Customer Success motion — and a clear maintenance cadence that keeps them current as the product and playbooks evolve

• Demonstrate the impact of agentic solutions on reduced customer time to value, reduced time spent detecting and resolving risks, and increased retention

• Have a track record of improving solutions after launch: performance improvements measured in real customer outcomes, not just benchmark scores

• Be the go-to expert at Samsara for customer-facing agentic AI development — advising Customer Success leadership on what to build next, what to retire, and how to evaluate ideas before committing to them

• Help define what great looks like for ing at Samsara, setting a standard others can build on towards using AI to expand the pipeline

Minimum requirements for the role:

• Hands-on experience building and maintaining production LLM-based agents or automations 

• Python proficiency and a track record of connecting AI to external systems: CRMs, APIs, customer data, and operational tools

• The discipline to define what success looks like before you start building — and an eval framework that catches problems before your users do

• A genuine curiosity about Customer Success workflows and customer problems, not just the technical challenge

• Intellectual honesty about what AI can and can't do well — and the judgment to design guardrails and fallback paths accordingly

• 3+ years of software engineering or technical experience, with at least 1 year working hands-on with LLMs or AI agents in a production environment

• Experience in a B2B SaaS environment

An ideal candidate also has:

• Direct experience with Anthropic Claude or similar LLM APIs

• A background working with or alongside a Customer Success or Revenue Operations team

• Experience building regression test suites or eval …

Joining Collibra’s Sales team

Our customers are under pressure to deliver more value from their data while building a strong foundation for AI. As an Account Manager, you’ll help them connect those priorities to their investment in Collibra.

You’ll own the commercial relationship with a portfolio of existing customers, with responsibility for renewals and expansion. You’ll build relationships across each account, understand what customers need to achieve, and develop a clear plan to retain and grow their business.

Working closely with Customer Success, Customer Engineering and other teams across Collibra, you’ll connect customer outcomes with commercial opportunities. That includes strengthening adoption of our data governance products and identifying where our AI products can address additional business needs.

Account Managers at Collibra are responsible for

• Owning renewal and expansion sales across a portfolio of existing customers, with accountability for retention, growth and quota attainment

• Building account plans that connect customer priorities, business outcomes, stakeholder relationships and commercial opportunities

• Developing relationships with executive sponsors, business leaders, technical stakeholders and procurement teams

• Leading discovery to understand changing customer needs and identify opportunities for additional products and broader use across the organization

• Partnering with Customer Success to understand adoption, demonstrate value and address risks ahead of renewal

• Managing the full commercial process, from identifying and qualifying opportunities through proposals, negotiation and close

• Coordinating the right expertise across Collibra to address customer needs and move opportunities forward

• Maintaining an accurate pipeline and forecast, with clear next steps, decision criteria and timelines for each opportunity

• Bringing customer feedback to internal teams to inform how we improve our products and customer experience

You have

• 3+ years of quota-carrying account management or sales experience in enterprise software or SaaS

• A track record of achieving renewal and expansion targets across existing customer accounts

• Experience managing complex sales cycles involving multiple stakeholders, procurement and contract negotiations

• Experience building account plans and developing relationships with executive decision-makers

• The ability to lead discovery and translate technical capabilities into a clear business case

• Experience identifying account risk and coordinating action across sales, customer success and technical teams

• Familiarity with data management, data governance or AI, or experience learning and selling complex enterprise technology

• A bachelor’s degree or equivalent relevant working experience

You are

• Curious about your customers’ businesses and persistent in understanding what matters to them

• Commercially focused, with sound judgment about how to build lasting customer relationships

• Proactive in identifying opportunities and addressing concerns before they become barriers to renewal or growth

• Clear and confident in conversations with both executive and technical audiences

• Collaborative and accountable, bringing the right people together and following through on commitments

• Organized and disciplined in managing your accounts, pipeline and forecast

Measures of success

• Within your first month, you will learn Collibra’s portfolio and sales process, build relationships with your account teams, and understand the priorities, renewal timelines and risks across your assigned customers.

• Within your third month, you will have actionable account plans for your priority customers, established relationships with key stakeholders, and a qualified renewal and expansion pipeline.

• Within your sixth month, you will independently manage your portfolio, demonstrate progress against your retention and expansion targets, and provide a reliable forecast supported by clear customer commitments and next steps.

Benefits at Collibra

Collibra recognizes and values that everyone has different needs, interests, and life goals. We built our benefits program with flexibility in mind to support you and your loved ones through a diverse range of circumstances and life events. These flexible offerings sit on a foundation of competitive compensation, health coverage, and time off. Learn more about Collibra’s benefits.

We create inclusion and belonging through how we onboard, meet, connect, engage, and communicate. Learn more about diversity, equity, and inclusion at Collibra.

What You’ll Do

• Own the SaaS product line number: partner with core Account Executives to identify, qualify, and close SaaS data protection and security opportunities across net-new and existing accounts.

• Lead with technical credibility: articulate Rubrik’s SaaS architecture, security posture, and the gaps in Microsoft’s and Google’s native shared responsibility model in a way that resonates with both technical and business buyers.

What You’ll Bring

• Directly relevant background: experience at a SaaS data protection or management vendor is strongly preferred.

• Genuine technical depth: comfortable discussing tenant architecture, APIs, identity and access management (Entra ID/Azure AD), backup and recovery mechanics, and security and compliance frameworks without relying solely on a Sales Engineer.

• Proven technical selling motion: a track record of running or co-leading technical discovery and proof-of-concept engagements, not just handing off to a technical resource.

• Consultative approach: comfortable navigating complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles across IT, security, and executive buyers in mid-market and enterprise accounts.

• Overlay/specialist experience: prior success working in a platform-selling model alongside core Account Executives, Sales Engineers, and Customer Success.

• Track record: consistent history of quota attainment and strong pipeline generation.

• Education: bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.

Nice to Have

• Hands-on familiarity with Microsoft 365 administration, Entra ID/Azure AD, or Salesforce administration.

• Experience selling a data security or resiliency platform that spans SaaS, cloud, and on-premises workloads.

• Existing relationships with IT, security, or compliance buyers in target accounts

Why Rubrik

Rubrik is a leader in data security and cyber resilience, helping the world's leading organizations secure and recover their data from cyberattacks and operational disruptions. Joining the Product Line Sales organization means working at the intersection of deep technical expertise and high-growth sales — with the backing of Rubrik's platform, brand, and go-to-market engine.

Rubrik (NYSE: RBRK) is the Security and AI Operations Company, delivering one platform built at the intersection of data, identity, and AI. About the Role

The Strategic Project Lead – AI Post-Training will help lead AI companies develop and improve frontier models through high-quality data programs. We’re looking for someone with experience in AI post-training, preference data, or model evaluation to lead projects that shape how models respond, reason, and perform. 

You’ll own delivery while bringing practical knowledge of the data, evaluation methods, and quality standards behind model improvement. Working closely with clients and internal teams, you’ll help translate evolving AI research needs into clear workflows, reliable datasets, and measurable outcomes. 

Your Impact

• Own end-to-end project delivery, including scope, timelines, budgets, staffing, and risk management. 

• Lead client communication, status reporting, planning sessions, and escalations. 

• Translate model improvement objectives into data requirements, workflows, rubrics, and evaluation plans. 

• Define quality standards and acceptance criteria for preference data, model comparisons, and evaluation outputs. 

• Monitor delivery quality, investigate inconsistencies, and resolve ambiguous requirements with clients. 

• Advise on data design, evaluation approaches, and project feasibility based on your domain expertise. 

• Develop reusable guidelines, SOPs, and QA frameworks to improve consistency across programs. 

• Mentor Operations Specialists and contribute to project scoping, pilots, and new capability development. 

What You Bring

• 1–2+ years of experience in AI data operations, project coordination, or delivery, ideally in a GenAI or frontier AI environment.

• Familiarity with at least one AI post-training or model evaluation workflow. 

• Experience coordinating projects or workstreams, managing stakeholders, and communicating with clients.

• Understanding of data quality, annotation workflows, and quality assurance methods.

• Ability to translate evolving requirements into clear workflows, rubrics, and measurable quality standards. 

• Strong troubleshooting and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities. 

• Interest in current AI developments, including frontier models and post-training approaches. 

Nice to Have

• Experience with reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF), preference data, or model response evaluation.

• Familiarity with rubric design, model comparison, benchmark development, or evaluation creation.

• Experience assessing model responses for quality, accuracy, reasoning, or instruction following.

• Exposure to AI companies, frontier AI labs, or model evaluation programs.

• Bilingual capabilities, particularly German or a Nordic language. 

Why You'll Love Working Here

At Appen, we foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and excellence. We value curiosity, accountability, and a commitment to delivering the highest quality AI solutions for frontier models.

You'll work on complex challenges that shape the future of AI across industries and geographies, alongside talented people in a culture that values humility over ego. You'll have the flexibility to deliver in a way that works for you and your team, supported by tools, resources, and development opportunities to continue to build your capability over time.

About Appen

Appen has been a leader in AI training data for over 30 years. We specialise in human generated data to train, fine tune, and evaluate models across generative AI, large language models, computer vision, and speech recognition. Our AI assisted data annotation platform and global crowd of more than 1 million contributors in over 200 countries support model pre training, supervised fine tuning, evaluation and benchmarking, safety and red teaming, and multilingual global expansion.

52e1d4e9c27a64e5.description:
Headquarters: Remote

About Carrot: 

Carrot is the leading global fertility and family care platform, built on intelligent care orchestration: the right clinical guidance, at the right moment, in the context of each member’s life. More than a thousand multinational employers, health plans, and health systems trust Carrot to support millions of members across 195 countries – from pre-pregnancy through menopause and major life moments in between. Carrot's comprehensive clinical program delivers industry-leading cost savings for plan sponsors and award-winning experiences and improved outcomes for millions of people worldwide.

Carrot is widely regarded as a defining force in healthcare innovation as a recipient of several top-tier awards, including Fast Company's 'Most Innovative Companies' and CNBC's '100 Barrier Breaking Startups'. The company is regularly cited by leading global outlets — including The Economist, Bloomberg, The Wall Street Journal, NPR, ABC News, and Harvard Business Review — as a leading voice on digital health, the future of work, and family health. Learn more at get-carrot.com.
The Opportunity 

Carrot is looking for a Sr. IT Systems Engineer to design, scale, and secure the identity, endpoint, and SaaS platforms that power our global, remote-first workforce. You will set the technical direction for how employees and devices connect to Carrot systems, while staying hands-on in the tooling, automation, and complex problem-solving that make IT reliable at scale.

This role sits at the center of IT engineering. You will lead larger initiatives from design through rollout, partner closely with Information Security on zero-trust and compliance priorities, and raise the bar for the rest of the team through standards, documentation, and mentorship. If you want broad technical ownership, influence over the IT roadmap, and the chance to build systems that grow with a high-growth healthcare company, this role was built for that.

What You’ll Own 

In this role, you will:

• Architect and own Carrot's identity, endpoint, and SaaS platforms, including Okta, JAMF, Intune, and Google Workspace, with a focus on security, reliability, and user experience

• Lead design and rollout of larger IT initiatives, such as zero-trust access models, device compliance frameworks, and global endpoint standards

• Build and maintain automation and infrastructure as code that manage configuration, provisioning, and lifecycle workflows at scale

• Partner with Information Security to design controls, drive vulnerability management, and keep Carrot audit-ready for SOC 2, HIPAA, and customer security reviews

• Serve as the senior technical escalation point, leading incident response and root cause analysis for complex or high-impact issues

• Define engineering standards, runbooks, and documentation, and mentor IT teammates to grow their technical depth

• Evaluate vendors and tools, build business cases, and make clear recommendations on build versus buy tradeoffs

• Design environments that support global care and operations teams, including secure and efficient remote computing setups

• Contribute to the IT roadmap and communicate priorities, risks, and progress to technical and business stakeholders

What Success Looks Like  

In your first 12–18 months, you will have:

• Established a clear, documented architecture and standards for identity, endpoint, and SaaS management that the team can build on

• Delivered at least one major platform initiative, such as a zero-trust access model or endpoint modernization, with measurable gains in security posture and employee experience

• Reduced manual IT work through automation and infrastructure as code, with a measurable drop in recurring ticket volume

• Strengthened audit readiness, contributing to clean results on security and compliance reviews

• Raised the technical capability of the team through mentorship, documentation, and shared standards

• Built trusted partnerships with Information Security, People, Engineering, and Finance

About You 

You likely have:

• 6+ years of experience in IT systems engineering, endpoint engineering, or infrastructure roles, including ownership of production platforms

• Deep, hands-on expertise with identity and access platforms such as Okta, including SSO, SCIM, lifecycle automation, and conditional access

• Expert-level experience managing Mac and Windows fleets with JAMF and Intune, including packaging, deployment, security policy, and compliance enforcement

• Strong scripting and automation skills (for example Python, Bash, or PowerShell), with experience using APIs and source-controlled configuration

• Experience designing and implementing security controls, such as encryption, vulnerability management, and zero-trust principles, in partnership with Security teams

• A track record of leading cross-functional technical projects from design through rollout without direct authority

• Experience mentoring or technically guiding other engineers

• Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate complex tradeoffs for executive and non-technical audiences

Nice to Have ⭐

While not required, we would be especially excited if you bring:

• Experience in healthcare, health tech, or another regulated environment (for example, HIPAA or SOC 2)

• Experience with infrastructure as code and CI/CD practices applied to endpoint or SaaS configuration

• Hands-on experience with AWS or GCP and modern cloud networking concepts

• Experience designing remote computing environments for call center or clinical operations teams, such as VDI or managed browser models

• Experience building AI-assisted workflows or tooling to improve IT operations

• Relevant certifications (for example JAMF Certified Expert, Okta Certified Professional, or Microsoft Endpoint Administrator)

Why This Role Matters 

Every Carrot employee depends on technology that is secure, reliable, and easy to use, whether they are supporting members through deeply personal care journeys or partnering with global employers. This role sets the technical foundation that makes that possible.

As Carrot continues to scale across geographies and functions, the architecture and standards you establish will protect member trust, strengthen our security posture, and give the business the speed and confidence to keep growing.

Why Candidates Join Carrot 

Carrot offers the opportunity to do meaningful work in service of a deeply human mission.

Highlights include:

• A mission-driven company focused on expanding access to fertility and family-forming care globally.

• A high-growth environment where leaders are empowered to shape strategy and drive impact.

• Competitive compensation, equity, and comprehensive benefits.

• Flexible Time Off and a culture that actively encourages employees to recharge.

• Comprehensive parental leave and family-forming benefits.

• A collaborative, inclusive, and values-driven culture.

• The opportunity to work alongside passionate, thoughtful teammates committed to improving healthcare outcomes worldwide.

Compensation

Carrot offers a holistic Total Rewards package designed to support our employees in all aspects of their lives inside and outside of work, including health and wellness benefits, retirement savings plans, short- and long-term incentives, parental leave, family-forming assistance, and a competitive compensation package.

• Base Salary Range: $150,000 – $175,000 (primary range).

• Geo-Tier Adjustment: Up to $190,000 for highly experienced candidates within 50 miles of San Francisco, NYC, or Seattle.

Actual compensation may vary from the posted base salary depending on your confirmed job-related skills and experience.

Fraud and Security Notice: Please note that all communication regarding job opportunities at Carrot will come exclusively from an @get-carrot.com email address. If you receive messages from any other domain, please disregard …

Reinforcement learning and transfer learning.

Foundation model fine-tuning and model adaptation.

TensorFlow and PyTorch.

Hugging Face Transformers.

MLflow and experiment tracking.

Advanced hyperparameter tuning and neural architecture search.

Advanced Python programming.

C++ for performance optimization.

CUDA for GPU programming.

Quantization, pruning, and knowledge distillation.

ONNX and TensorRT.

Model compression and inference optimization techniques.

AWS SageMaker.

• 

Azure Machine Learning.

• 

Google Cloud Vertex AI.

Distributed model training and cloud-native AI architectures.

Kubernetes and Docker.

Model serving using TorchServe and TensorFlow Serving.

CI/CD pipelines for machine learning.

Production model monitoring and performance tracking.

Automated model deployment and retraining workflows.

7. Research and Innovation

• 

Literature reviews and experimental design.

Research methodologies and model benchmarking.

• 

Evaluation of emerging AI technologies.

Natural Language Processing: BERT, GPT, and LLM fine-tuning.

• 

Computer Vision: YOLO and ResNet.

• 

Time-Series Forecasting: LSTM and Prophet.

Generative AI and foundation models.

Strong technical leadership and team mentoring capabilities.

Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and model evaluation skills.

Strong understanding of model lifecycle management, performance optimization, and responsible AI.

• 

Ability to collaborate with Data Science, Engineering, and MLOps teams.
